thread.title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) Position Boosted by Lbmc Investment Advisors LLC

author: ABMN Staff
title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) Position Boosted by Lbmc Investment Advisors LLC

organizations.name: lbmc investment advisors llc lbmc investment advisors llc

text:
Lbmc Investment Advisors LLC increased its holdings in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 17.6% in the second its most recent 13F filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The institutional investor owned 7,136 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after buying an additional 1,069 shares during the quarter. Apple comprises 0.2% of Lbmc Investment Advisors LLC’s portfolio, making the stock its 26th largest holding. Lbmc Investment Advisors LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $1,321,000 as of its most recent SEC filing.
Other hedge funds have also modified their holdings of the company. Delphi Private Advisors LLC bought a new position in Apple during the 2nd quarter valued at $120,000. Quattro Financial Advisors LLC bought a new position in Apple during the 1st quarter valued at $133,000. CX Institutional bought a new position in Apple during the 2nd quarter valued at $135,000. Spectrum Financial Alliance Ltd LLC bought a new position in Apple during the 1st quarter valued at $138,000. Finally, Gainplan LLC bought a new position in Apple during the 1st quarter valued at $200,000. 57.65% of the stock is owned by institutional investors and hedge funds.
